routes.name: Residence permit on a self-employment permit

note: Bulgaria, read on 2026-10-31 in the European Commission's EU Immigration Portal (Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs), its pages 'Employed worker in Bulgaria' and 'Self-employed worker in Bulgaria', both dated 1 April 2025 (secondary: the Commission's summary of the Law on Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria, whose consolidated text on lex.bg answered with a Cloudflare check and wasn't read). The single permit is applied for after an approval the employer obtains from the Employment Agency (with a labour market test, from which an actor-performer approved by the Ministry of Culture is exempt), on a type D visa, and obtained from the Migration Directorate once in Bulgaria; it gives the right to reside and to work at the employer named, is valid for at most one year and renewable up to three (then a month back home before a new one), and is tied to the employer and position (work: sponsor). A self-employed person holds a self-employment permit (at most one year, renewable up to three) and a residence permit from the Migration Directorate after entering, whose term is aligned with it; the work it allows isn't stated beyond the activity planned, so it isn't written. Long-term (permanent) residence may be asked for after five years of legal residence, at the Migration Directorate or a Bulgarian embassy or consulate (the employed worker's page names only the Directorate); its holder needs no work permit (work: any). The pages call it 'long-term residence' on one and 'permanent residence' on the other; the Law's own terms (продължително, постоянно, дългосрочно пребиваващ в ЕС) weren't read. No fee or decision time is given. EU, EEA and Swiss citizens' free movement isn't on these pages and isn't written here.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Employed worker in Bulgaria (1 April 2025)
sources.said: Once you have arrived in Bulgaria with your valid visa (in case you need a visa to enter the country), you must also obtain a Single permit itself from the Migration Directorate . Your Single permit gives you the right to reside in Bulgaria and work at the respective employer’s enterprise in Bulgaria. ... The Single permit is valid for a maximum of one year, renewable for a maximum of up to three years. ... Single/Work permits are issued to a specific employee and to the specific position and type of work. Change is not allowed. ... an actor-performer, approved by the Ministry of Culture; ... You will be eligible for long-term residence status after five years of legal residence. ... As a long-term resident, you will not need a single/work permit and will have equal access to health insurance and social security.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Self-employed worker in Bulgaria (1 April 2025)
sources.said: you must also obtain a residence permit from the Migration Directorate after you enter Bulgaria ... The Self-employment Permit is valid for a maximum of one year, renewable for a maximum of up to three years. ... The duration of the residence permit is aligned with the Self-employment permit. ... You will be eligible for permanent residence status after five years of legal residence. ... Applications for permanent residence must be submitted to the Migration Directorate of the Ministry of Interior, or to the Bulgarian embassy or consulate in your home country . ... As a permanent resident, you will not need a work permit
